title: Version pill and change log
summary: See which version of the intranet you are using, and read what changed in each release.

added: The footer shows the version of the intranet that is running. Select it to open the change log.
A change log page, under Support, that lists the changes in each release that are relevant to you, with a filter by type of change.
accessibility: The version link and the change log filter work with a keyboard and with screen readers.

internal_notes: Release notes are reviewed files in the repository, synced into the hub on every deploy. The health check now reports the deployed version as well as the revision.
